description: Connects the web flow runner to its desktop host, WebFlow.sys.mjs. Android uses native messaging instead.

events.name: onConfigure
events.description: Fired when the host starts an attempt.

parameters.name: attempt
parameters.description: The attempt id, the tab the journey runs in and the journey config.

functions.name: getAttempt
functions.description: Returns the attempt in progress, or null.

functions.name: report
functions.description: Sends a message from the runner to the host.
